description: This PHP source file defines the ReviewerUserRole class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends AbstractUserRole and provides methods to determine accessible employee, tracker, and tracker log IDs for a reviewer based on permissions and user context.

classes.name: ReviewerUserRole
classes.description: A class representing a user role for reviewers, providing methods to retrieve IDs of entities accessible to the reviewer based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns entity IDs accessible to the reviewer for a given entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs that the reviewer has access to, based on specific permission settings.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs accessible to the reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker log IDs accessible to the reviewer.
